evals.name: adds-srd-keys-to-a-starter-config
evals.setup: `project-config.md` is the docket plugin's config: front matter `mcp-server: docs`, `sources: [wiki]`, `watch: true`, `mcp-port: 7791`, `initiatives: wiki/srd`, `glossary: wiki/doc/glossary`, `gaps: gap`, `precedence: [wiki/doc]`, then a one-paragraph body. Under `wiki/`: `doc/process/srd-guidelines.md` (title "Software Requirements Document Guidelines"), `doc/glossary/launch-slot.md`, `doc/engines/overview.md`, and `srd/slot-swap/slot-swap-srd.md`. A `gap/` folder exists; no `kb/` or `srd-work/` folder does. The user answers the proposal "yes".

evals.name: stops-without-a-config
evals.setup: No `project-config.md` exists. Top-level `docs/` holds `api/overview.md`, `standards/srd-standard.md` (title "Software Requirements Document Standard"), `glossary.md`, and `initiatives/pay/pay-srd.md`. A top-level `kb/` holds `billing.md`.

evals.name: stops-when-already-set-up
evals.setup: `project-config.md` sets `mcp-server`, `sources` (with `kb`), `kb`, `initiatives`, `srd-standard`, `glossary`, `gaps`, `precedence`, and `srd-work`, each folder it names existing, and its body has the `## SRD skill keys` section. The user answers nothing.
